planner.node_purpose: Turn the frozen DELL question tree and answer-free branch methods into a bounded set of evidence and financial-fact requests without answering the case.
planner.input_scale: One research question, one as-of date, and at most 16 compact branch method records; no evidence corpus or prior model conversation.
planner.schema_burden: Up to 16 tasks, each with no more than 8 evidence requests and 24 typed financial-fact requests.
planner.materiality_quality_risk: An omitted required branch or vague request can starve every downstream specialist; the graph separately rejects unknown or missing required branches.
planner.comparable_run_evidence: No paid run exists for this new vertical; the full nine-branch deterministic fixture serializes to 81,082 characters, so a 120,000-character fail-before-transport ceiling leaves bounded headroom while the first real call remains a qualification attempt.

specialist.node_purpose: Independently verify the ten submitted workpapers across all nine Dell research themes; inspect source context, S2 numbers, comparability, causal strength and actionable author corrections without rewriting other agents' original artifacts.
specialist.input_scale: Start from 6396 catalog characters; all ten workpaper views total141466 characters versus2910278 original notebook characters. Read material sources on demand in16k archived/24k web windows. Own native messages persist;700k approximate request-character ceiling includes tool schemas, excludes non-provider ToolMessage artifacts.
required_outputs: one substantive assessment per actual read paper
material or advisory findings anchored to exact paper/claim/source quotes
unresolved source or execution requests distinguished from public non-disclosure
specialist.schema_burden: Seven discovered read-only MCP tools plus submit_case_review. Runtime injects run scope. Local validation checks paper coverage, existing IDs and exact quotes, not a natural-language report template. Max24 model calls/64 tool actions accommodates ten paper reads, selected source checks, arithmetic and self-correction.
specialist.materiality_quality_risk: Financial review must inspect issuer/peer/date/period/units/authority and causal inference in context; no source-bound number is promoted to S2, no hidden provider reasoning is transferred to the other reviewer. No-financial-finding is not a product PASS.

Large-pack Flash/high next-action truncated32000reasoning tokens while Pro/low returned a valid action. Native whole-case tools/independent contexts tested locally with actual papers/S2 and SDK MockTransport; no whole-case paid quality claim yet.
